chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'From the faith is good character and feeding the food.'
ai.seo_question: What are the components of faith according to this hadith from Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates feeding others from a mere charitable act to an essential pillar of *Iman*, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the inseparability of belief and social responsibility. This hadith is frequently cited in discussions on *Akhlaq* (ethics) to demonstrate that spiritual sincerity is validated through tangible acts of generosity and good conduct towards the community.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘From the Eman (faith) is the beautiful manners and feeding of the food’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Having good moral behavior and serving food is part of belief.’”
